claim: Add a virtual read of figure pixels only where the game's logic reads them; where boxes overwrite the player it would be wrong.

evidence.text: Bubbles read Dizzy's pixels: dedicated bubble virtual read; 7,436 bubble tests (340 Dizzy-dependent) identical.
Collision reads ULA ^ objects ^ Dizzy through a virtual read; hooks compute the original's new byte from the virtual old one.
No game logic reads the player's pixels: no virtual read, since boxes overwrite the player.
Original leaves ghost pixels; nothing else reads that buffer, so no virtual read is needed.
